data.title: The Heights Country Club and Wellness
data.about:
The Heights Country Club & Wellness is a forest-inspired master community by Emaar Properties that redefines villa living through a strong focus on wellness, nature, and balance. Designed as a low-density residential destination, the community offers thoughtfully planned 3 to 5-bedroom villas set amid lush greenery, landscaped gardens, and serene water features. 

Every element is curated to support a calmer, more intentional lifestyle, where open skies, walkable green spaces, and wellness-led amenities become part of everyday living rather than an occasional escape.

Perfectly positioned near Al Maktoum International Airport, The Heights enjoys seamless connectivity to Dubai’s key destinations while maintaining a sense of privacy and retreat. 

Located within Dubai’s new growth epicenter, the community appeals to both end-users and long-term investors seeking space, quality, and future relevance.

characteristics_module.title: The Heights by Emaar: A Community Built for Well-Being
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Master Developer - Backed by Emaar, one of Dubai’s key developers, known for delivering large-scale communities with sustained demand and resale depth.
  • Park-Led Community Planning - Villas are surrounded by landscaped parkland, reversing the typical layout and enhancing privacy, views, and long-term desirability.
  • Wellness-First Living Concept - The master plan is built around wellness as a daily lifestyle, not an add-on, integrating meditation zones, water yoga areas, and a residents-only spa.
  • Low-Density Community - A collection of spacious 3, 4, and 5-bedroom villas with generous built-up and plot sizes, supporting end-user demand and premium positioning.
  • Strategic Location - Positioned with direct access to major highways, enabling smooth connectivity to Expo City Dubai and other key destinations.
  • Airport Proximity Advantage - Close access to Al Maktoum International Airport strengthens appeal for frequent travelers and internationally mobile homeowners.

image.name: The Heights Country Club and Wellness Location

location_tile.title: Enjoy a Resort-Like Lifestyle With a Focus on Wellness and Luxury
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Located at the junction of E611 and E77, the project enjoys direct access to two of Dubai’s key arterial road networks, enabling efficient movement across the city while maintaining a peaceful residential setting. This strategic positioning places residents within comfortable driving distance of Expo City Dubai, Dubai Hills Estate, and Downtown Dubai, supporting both lifestyle convenience and long-term investment value.

AREAS NEARBY:

  • 10 minutes to Expo City Dubai
  • 10 minutes to Al Maktoum International Airport
  • 20 minutes to Dubai Hills Estate
  • 20 minutes to Downtown Dubai
